newsitem.title: NIGERIA: SOCCER-POOR AFRICAN PITCHES TO BE BANNED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-POOR AFRICAN PITCHES TO BE BANNED.

text.p: Sub-standard pitches would soon be banned for African internationals, Confederation of African Football (CAF) president Issa Hayatou said on Saturday.
Hayatou , on a two-day private visit to Nigeria, said that CAF would set up a committee to look at the state of pitches throughout the continent.
"There have been complaints about the poor state of pitches in many African countries and this is worrisome," he said.
"I have seen international matches played on poor pitches, including the recent World Cup qualifier between Kenya and Nigeria in Nairobi."
Nigerian coach Amodu Shaibu criticised the surface as "poor and patchy".

"CAF will soon set up a committee to look at the state of pitches on the continent. Any considered too poor to host international matches will be banned and have the game transferred elsewhere," Hayatou said.
